videos.title: Plus que le football : construire son identité | ExtraTime Kinshasa
videos.description:
Dans cet épisode spécial tourné à Kinshasa, Daniel et Haggi partagent une conversation vraie et profonde sur le football, la discipline et la vie au-delà du terrain. ⚽️

Entre mentalité de compétiteur, choix de l’entrepreneuriat et identité en dehors du foot, cet échange va parler à tous ceux qui veulent aller plus loin que le jeu.

🎙️ Pas de discipline = pas de réussite.
🎙️ Tu es plus que ce que tu fais.

Un épisode authentique, inspirant, et ancré dans la réalité.

#extratime  #kinshasa  #football  #discipline  #mindset  #entrepreneuriat  #congo

videos.title: Full Circle - Coach Pitso Mosimane⭕️🌍⚽️
videos.description:
From player to coach to mentor and beyond, Coach Pitso Mosimane reflects on the full circle nature of his illustrious journey. In this exclusive episode, we explore how he's using his ExtraTIME to give back, mentor, and shape the next generation through Pitso Mosimane Soccer Schools.

Get a rare look at how one of Africa’s most decorated football minds is developing not just skilled athletes, but well-rounded individuals, the holistic player of tomorrow.

videos.title: Purpose - Bigger Than Football Pt.2 🌍⚽️
videos.description: Part Two – Football continues to reveal deeper lessons beyond the pitch. In this follow-up episode, Coach Cavin Johnson and Jesse Donn dive deeper into the journey of identity, the power of mentorship, and preparing young athletes for purpose beyond the game. The journey doesn’t end with the final whistle, it’s just the beginning.

videos.title: Purpose - Bigger Than Football 🌍⚽️
videos.description:
Bigger Than Football – Identity, Mentorship, and Guidance. 🌍🚀⚽️

Football is more than just a game, it’s a journey of self-discovery. Join our guests, coach Cavin Johnson and former Bafana Bafana A and SuperSport United player Jesse Donn, as they share the importance of young athletes discovering their identity, receiving mentorship, and finding guidance for life beyond the sport.

videos.title: AUTHENTICITY  🚀
videos.description:
In this second episode, we delve into the essence of authenticity with our guest, the visionary and multidisciplinary visual artist, Kay Kay Ribane. Known for pushing the boundaries of art and self-expression, Kay Kay explores how true value is discovered from within, encouraging us to dream big and envision new possibilities.

"We are all designed authentically"

True value comes from within. By self-discovery, you tap into your deepest aspirations. Dreaming big and having a clear vision aren’t just external pursuits; they are guided by an internal compass that aligns with your core values and self-worth. As you dig deeper into your authentic desires, your dreams become more meaningful, and your vision grows stronger.
